mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_case (case_id, agent_id, title, summary, case_type, severity, frequency, affected_sessions, importance_score, confidence, total_score, status, skill_id, source_model, extraction_reason, owner, resolution, last_seen_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{caseId}, #{agentId}, #{title}, #{summary}, #{caseType}, #{severity}, #{frequency}, #{affectedSessions}, #{importanceScore}, #{confidence}, #{totalScore}, #{status}, #{skillId}, #{sourceModel}, #{extractionReason}, #{owner}, #{resolution}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_case SET title=#{title}, case_type=#{caseType}, status=#{status}, skill_id=#{skillId}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE case_id=#{caseId}
UPDATE ai_case SET frequency=frequency+1, updated_at=NOW() WHERE case_id=#{caseId}
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM ai_case c WHERE c.case_id=#{caseId} AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1)

SELECT c.* FROM ai_case c WHERE c.status='active' AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1) ORDER BY c.frequency DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.* FROM ai_case c WHERE c.status=#{status} AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1) ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_case c WHERE c.status=#{status} AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_case c WHERE NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1)

SELECT c.* FROM ai_case c WHERE c.status='active' AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1) AND (c.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.case_type LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR c.skill_id LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY c.frequency DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.* FROM ai_case c WHERE c.agent_id=#{agentId} AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1) AND c.status IN ('CANDIDATE','PENDING_REVIEW','CONFIRMED','IN_PROGRESS','RESOLVED') ORDER BY c.total_score DESC, c.last_seen_at DESC, c.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.* FROM ai_case c WHERE c.agent_id=#{agentId} AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1) AND (#{status}='' OR c.status=#{status}) ORDER BY c.total_score DESC, c.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.* FROM ai_case c WHERE c.agent_id=#{agentId} AND c.case_id=#{caseId} AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1) LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.* FROM ai_case c INNER JOIN case_evidence e ON e.case_id = c.case_id AND e.agent_id = c.agent_id WHERE c.agent_id=#{agentId} AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1) AND e.session_id=#{sessionId} ORDER BY c.total_score DESC, c.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_case c WHERE c.agent_id=#{agentId} AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_case c WHERE c.agent_id=#{agentId} AND NULLIF(TRIM(c.skill_id),'') IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_skill sk WHERE sk.agent_id=c.agent_id AND sk.skill_id=c.skill_id AND sk.status=1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_agent_mcp mc WHERE mc.agent_id=c.agent_id AND mc.status=1) AND c.status=#{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_case SET summary=#{summary}, severity=#{severity}, frequency=#{frequency}, affected_sessions=#{affectedSessions}, importance_score=#{importanceScore}, confidence=#{confidence}, total_score=#{totalScore}, status=#{status}, source_model=#{sourceModel}, extraction_reason=#{extractionReason}, last_seen_at=#{lastSeenAt}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND case_id=#{caseId}

UPDATE ai_case SET status=#{toStatus}, owner=CASE WHEN #{owner}='' THEN owner ELSE #{owner} END, resolution=CASE WHEN #{resolution}='' THEN resolution ELSE #{resolution} END, updated_at=NOW() WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND case_id=#{caseId} AND status=#{fromStatus}
UPDATE ai_case SET status='MERGED', merged_to_case_id=#{targetCaseId}, resolution=#{resolution}, updated_at=NOW() WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND case_id=#{caseId} AND status=#{fromStatus}
